comment: LINE MACROS, the fused 'Investigate & crack' -- SECOND (DEFERRED) half (docs/design/viewer-line-macros.md). Once the Clue is really on the battlefield its '{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card' is an ordinary searched ActivatePermAbility and the crack validates as a plain line -- no {T} in that cost, so a Clue made this turn is crackable this turn (the card's own note). That is the whole reason the fused gesture defers the crack rather than dropping it: the second segment is not a special case, it is this line, run against the board the first segment produces. Two Conservatories pay the {2}.
